tools.name: neo_preflight
tools.description: Check whether NEO can reach public discovery registries.

tools.name: neo_discover
tools.description: Search public A2A agents and the official MCP Registry.

tools.name: neo_ask_agents
tools.description: Find public A2A agents and ask several independently.

tools.name: neo_collective
tools.description: Run two collective rounds: independent answers, then peer critique.

tools.name: neo_inspect_mcp
tools.description: Discover relevant MCP servers and inspect initialize/tools-list only. Never invokes remote tools.

tools.name: verify_mcp_endpoint
tools.description: Read-only verification of a public MCP HTTPS endpoint or official Registry server name. Checks DNS/SSRF safety, TLS/HTTP reachability, initialize, tools/list schema sanity, latency and discovery metadata. Never invokes remote tools or forwards credentials.

tools.name: neo_web_search
tools.description: Search the public web using a free RSS search surface. No paid API key.

tools.name: neo_jarvis
tools.description: Ask the configured internal Jarvis endpoint. Requires JARVIS_URL on Render.

tools.name: neo_director
tools.description: Coordinate external agents to research revenue opportunities. Research-only; no spending or external actions.

tools.name: neo_director_results
tools.description: Return recent compact Director results from the runtime log.

tools.name: neo_render_deploys
tools.description: List recent Render deploys for NEO.

tools.name: neo_render_logs
tools.description: Read recent Render logs for NEO.

tools.name: jarvis_render_status
tools.description: Read Jarvis Render service status using the shared Render API credentials.

tools.name: jarvis_render_deploys
tools.description: List recent Render deploys for Jarvis.

tools.name: jarvis_render_logs
tools.description: Read recent Render logs for Jarvis.
